label: User Choice
title: User Choice
subtitle: Lets an agent pause and present the user with a set of labeled buttons in the chat. The user can click one of the options or type a free-form response to guide the agent.
whenToUse: Use when an agent reaches a decision point and needs explicit user input before continuing — for example, choosing between implementation approaches, confirming a plan, or selecting from discovered options.

methods.name: Present Choices
methods.description: Shows the user a prompt with 2–6 labeled buttons. The user clicks a button or types a custom response. The agent receives the selection and continues.

mediaCaption: A User Choice card showing a question prompt with labeled choice buttons and a text field for custom responses
